title: Sonic R Port
summary: Native 30 FPS racing on Cardputer Zero using your PC copy of Sonic R.
description: Play the PC edition of Sonic R on the Cardputer Zero with native 320×170 VC4 graphics, keyboard controls, and local saves. First-launch setup imports your installed 1998 PC game from internal storage, SD, or USB. Supply the original SONICR.EXE and game folders. The app prepares the native runtime on the Zero.
